description: Source code for the NTLM client implementation, including message parsing, response generation, and security buffer management within the net::ntlm namespace.

classes.name: NtlmClient
classes.description: Handles NTLM authentication message generation and parsing, including support for NTLMv1 and NTLMv2.

methods.name: GetNegotiateMessage
methods.description: Returns the pre-generated NTLM negotiate message.

methods.name: GenerateAuthenticateMessage
methods.description: Generates the NTLM authenticate message based on provided credentials and challenge.

methods.name: CalculatePayloadLayout
methods.description: Calculates the layout of the payload buffers for the authenticate message.

methods.name: GetAuthenticateHeaderLength
methods.description: Returns the length of the authenticate message header depending on NTLM version.

methods.name: GetNtlmResponseLength
methods.description: Returns the length of the NTLM response payload based on NTLM version and target info length.
